history.mark.label: {name}, {time}

history.revert.title: Go back to “{name}”?

history.revert.hint: Nothing is erased: the current text is kept as a version, you can come back to it.
history.undo.hint: Only this change is removed; what was written since stays.

history.compare.variant: Compare the main text with variant “{name}”
history.row.merged.sub: Its changes are in the text

history.readonly: You can read and compare, not change: your role is reader.
history.note: Going back adds a change: nothing is erased, and you can still go back to “now”. A variant lets you try another wording without touching the shared text, then merge it or set it aside.
history.variant.editing: You are editing the variant “{name}”: the main text is untouched.
